WITH filtered AS (SELECT * FROM expense_notes WHERE user_id = $1),
     summary AS (SELECT count(*)::text AS total_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) * 100, 0)::numeric(100,0)::text AS total_cents FROM filtered)
     SELECT summary.*, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC)
       FROM (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3) p), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
       
     FROM summary

     FROM summary

WITH filtered AS (SELECT en.*, u.name AS author_name FROM users u
    JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM expense_notes WHERE user_id=u.id AND status='pending' OFFSET 0) en ON true
    WHERE u.company_id = $2 AND u.id <> $1 AND (u.role = 'hr_admin' OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM users direct_manager
    WHERE direct_manager.id = u.manager_id AND direct_manager.id <> u.id AND direct_manager.company_id = u.company_id
      AND direct_manager.role = 'manager' AND direct_manager.is_active
  ))),
     summary AS (SELECT count(*)::text AS total_count, COALESCE(sum(amount) * 100, 0)::numeric(100,0)::text AS total_cents FROM filtered)
     SELECT summary.*, COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC)
       FROM (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4) p), '[]'::jsonb) AS items
       
     FROM summary
